programs.title: Teri Talash Mein (dub)(unnaruge Naan Irundhal Tamil)
programs.desc: After her father's sudden death, Mahalakshmi is left to clear his debts and face the harsh villagers. A taxi driver helps her cremate her father and pledges his taxi to earn her a temporary reprieve.

programs.title: The Murderer
programs.desc: A hotel musician's life takes a turn for the unexpected after his admirer's presumed suicide. Considered a prime suspect himself, he does some investigation and comes to realize that the case is far more twisted than it appeared.

programs.title: Fight Club
programs.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.
